definitions: Handle or control (a tool, mechanism, etc.) typically in a skilful manner.
Control or influence (a person or situation) cleverly, unfairly, or unscrupulously.
Alter, manage, or process (information, a program, etc.) by using a computer or other means.
examples: He manipulated the controls of the machine.
The politician tried to manipulate public opinion.
The software allows you to manipulate data easily.
